changelog: **AIM recoil compensation (splines).** A time-based curve, triggered by your fire key, pushes the right stick to counter a weapon's recoil while you hold fire — independent of your aiming, so it works even when you don't move the mouse. You draw the pull as a 7-point curve per axis (px/s), set how long it lasts and how strong it is, and it ramps up and settles on its own. **Off by default** — nothing moves until you enable it and draw a curve. It lives in its own profile, so tuning it never touches your MIM or CIM settings. Configured in the Python control app's AIM tab (Firmware C). The fire trigger is selectable (a mouse button or a key).
